milestones.title: The Idea
milestones.description: The Purple Umbrella concept begins with the belief that climate conversations need to become more engaging, inclusive and youth-led.

milestones.title: The first Purple Umbrella Festival
milestones.description: Brings together young people and schools around climate-focused experiences and participation.

milestones.title: The Festival expands
milestones.description: The Foundation expands its platform through the Purple Umbrella Festival, with multiple tracks spanning theatre, film, innovation, talks, health, mental wellbeing and heritage.

milestones.title: Climate Promise launches
milestones.description: Climate Promise develops as a year-round citizen action initiative.

milestones.title: The Road Ahead
milestones.description: Building toward a community of one million young Climate Champions.
